name: Target Attributes Filter
description: Filter to add target attribute to hyperlinks.
project_description:
Override the hyperlink target attribute using text formats. Choose the target attribute value and whether it applies to all links, only internal, or only external links.

 Usage 
 
 Download and install the module. Recommended install method is composer:

 composer require drupal/target_attributes_filter 
 Go to the "Text formats and editors" configuration page (/admin/config/content/formats). 
 Edit the desired text format. 
 Enable the "Add target attribute to links" filter. 
 Review available configurations under filter settings and save changes.
